title: 有馬記念の後に・終わりではなく！

text_block_list.name: Creek and Inari
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O and Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Oguri and Yaeno
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Who will pull ahead and claim victory in this dream race?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: (Burn bright!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: BAMBOOOOO! MEMORYYYYY!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory has surged forward! She's in the lead and pulling further and further away from the pack!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Aaaaand Bamboo Memory has crossed the finish line! The sprint and mile champion has won this race of dreams!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: She did it. She really did show us a dream, huh, City?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: She sure did.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo and City
text_block_list.text: Maybe I have one more race in me after all. Heh, I think I got one more race in me after all.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That… That…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Was nowhere near full combustion!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: There's so much more fuel left in the tanks! Heck, that was hardly even the beginning!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I—no, we—can do better than that! We can blaze even brighter! We can still chase the ultimate race!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: This isn't the end!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: This is nowhere near the end of our dreams!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Haha! There's just no satisfying ya, is there?! Not that I'm complainin'. That's what it's all about!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I agree! In fact, I'm even more eager than Bamboo to reach greater heights!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe. ♪ I wonder how far we can go? Just thinking about it has my heart aflutter!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: As long as we have beloved rivals running by our sides, I believe our lights and our dreams will live on for eternity.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Fighting all of you for the top spot sounds… really fun.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Indeed. But be warned. I'll be the one standing victorious next time.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Let us keep challenging ourselves. Time and time again.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Prepare yourself, Bamboo Memory—Dream Blazer!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yeah! We'll keep showing everyone for as long as we run…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That we are the generation of red-hot passion!
